question_text: A Poisson variable satisfies P(X = 1) = P(X = 2). Find P(X = 5).

recall_prompt: Say how you would find P(X = 5) for this Poisson variable — what equation gives λ and what you substitute.
insider_note: Cancelling the common factor e⁻λ is the whole first mark: λ/1! = λ²/2! gives λ = 2, with λ = 0 rejected because a Poisson parameter is positive; leave e⁻² as it is in the answer — no decimals.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Find λ
steps.margin_note: First mark. Write the Poisson formula, set P(X = 1) = P(X = 2), and cancel the common factor e⁻λ: λ/1! = λ²/2! gives λ² = 2λ, so λ = 2 (λ = 0 is not allowed — a Poisson parameter is positive).

recall.must_convey: That P(X = 1) = P(X = 2) in the Poisson formula gives λ = λ²/2, so λ = 2.
accept: put r equal to one and two in the poisson formula, cancel e to the minus lambda, lambda equals lambda squared by two so lambda is two
P one equals P two gives lambda squared equals two lambda so lambda is two
cancel the common factor and solve, lambda comes to two
P one equals P two pedithe lambda square equals two lambda, lambda two
lambda is two because lambda cannot be zero

steps.why: A Poisson distribution has one parameter, λ, and the given equation fixes it. The factor e⁻λ appears on both sides and cancels, leaving a quadratic whose only positive root is 2.
common_mistakes: Writing 2! as 2 on one side and 1 on the other.
Cancelling λ² instead of λ and getting 1 = 2.

steps.label: Find P(X = 5)
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Put λ = 2 and r = 5: e⁻² · 2⁵/5! = 32e⁻²/120 = 4e⁻²/15. Leaving e⁻²·2⁵/5! unsimplified is accepted; do not replace e⁻² by a decimal.

recall.must_convey: That P(X = 5) = e⁻²·2⁵/5!, which simplifies to 4e⁻²/15.
accept: P of five is e to the minus two into two to the five by five factorial which is four e to the minus two by fifteen
put lambda two and r five in the formula, thirty two e to the minus two over one twenty
the answer is four e power minus two by fifteen
lambda two, r five pedithe e power minus two into thirty two by one twenty, four e power minus two by fifteen
e to the minus two times two to the fifth over five factorial

steps.why: Once λ is known the distribution is fully known, and any P(X = r) is one substitution. 2⁵ = 32 and 5! = 120 reduce to 4/15.
common_mistakes: Using λ = 1 or r = 2 by mixing up the given data with the question.
